implementation.targetScope: Text/regex highlighting and contextual clipping, with the Material React Table3.2.1 cell caller used by VentiMath. Adoption is separate.

changes: No copied upstream runtime; zero dependencies.
Deterministic per-list source-range keys preserve unchanged React chunk nodes.
Match ranges correct adjacent matches and nested/absent regex captures; zero-width matches never consume or duplicate text.
Bounded one-pattern cache avoids recompiling repeated table filters. No source text or chunks retained.
